[SWS_CM_CONSTR_00009] No service discovery for Signal-Based IEEE1722
ACF Network binding
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00006
⌈
Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF Network binding does not support service discovery. All
communication paths need to be configured statically.
⌋
4.1.7 Thread-safety
